Hello, my name is Yura Risuna, and I am a member of IRIAM! I really like the taste of light in Dan Fukuhara's bridal illustration, and I would like to request that you draw Yura for me!


Composition
I would like you to draw Yura Risuna rubbing her eyes while holding a fluffy light purple negligee and a stuffed squirrel on a bed in the morning sun.
She is posed sitting flat on her back. Please make sure that her face is facing forward and that the entire image is not obscured! I will leave the details of the body orientation and pose up to you!

Expression
She is winking and rubbing her eyes.
If you can add some facial expressions, it would be very helpful to have a smiling face with both eyes open and mouth open, a face with both eyes closed and mouth smiling, or a face with embarrassment, etc!


Character Information
Name: Yura Risuna
Occupation: High school teacher (in charge of art subjects)
Age: 20s
Height: 163cm
Gender: Female
Appearance: Purple wavy bangs, gold eyes, slightly protruding eyes, large breasts


Size: approx.
We would appreciate it if you could deliver separate data for the background and the character (PNG with transparent background).
The size should be 3000 x 4000, dpi 600 ⇐ or higher.


Usage
Thumbnails for distribution, SNS, goods, printed matter, distribution, etc.

Thank you for reading to the end, even though I am not used to it and it is poorly written.
Thank you again for your cooperation. 🙇‍♀️💓

IRIAM⬇
